title: VGI-SKT: Competition Solution for the 2026 BEHAVIOR Challenge
tldr: G0.5 post-trained with belief-graph chain-of-thought, skill-balanced sampling, and subtask-routed LoRA experts. Mean Q-score 0.445 and 22.3% full-task success over 1,000 public rollouts.
imageAlt: Method overview: G0.5 VLM predicts a subtask, which routes a skill-specific LoRA on the flow-matching action expert.
